ui.autostartBlocked: Start with Windows may have been blocked
ui.autostartWarnSw: Deskland-VN didn't start automatically this time — {sw} may have blocked it. Open {sw}, find Deskland-VN in its startup manager and set it to Allow.
ui.autostartWarnGeneric: Deskland-VN didn't start automatically this time — your security software or the Windows Startup apps setting may have blocked it. Turn Deskland-VN on in your security software's startup manager, or in Windows Settings → Apps → Startup.
ui.updateVersion: Deskland-VN {version} is ready. Your current theme and settings will be kept.
ui.updateCompleted: The update has been downloaded and installed. If Deskland-VN does not restart automatically, open it again.
ui.updateCanceled: The update was canceled. You can try again later.
ui.updateLowBattery: The update could not finish on battery power. Plug in your device and try again.
ui.updateWifiRecommended: This network may incur charges. Switch networks or try again later.
ui.updateWifiRequired: Connect to Wi-Fi to download this update.
ui.updateStoreRequired: This update method is only available in the Microsoft Store edition.
ui.updateFailed: The update failed. Check your connection or Microsoft Store and try again.
ui.updateChecking: Connecting to the update server and checking for a new version…
ui.networkTimeout: The connection or download timed out. Check your network, proxy or firewall and try again. If other websites work, the server may also be responding slowly.
ui.networkDns: The server address couldn't be resolved. Check your network, DNS or proxy settings and try again.
ui.networkTls: A secure connection couldn't be established. Check the system time and any security interception by your network or proxy, then try again.
ui.networkLocal: The network connection failed or was interrupted. Check your network, proxy or firewall and try again.
ui.serverUnavailable: The server was reached, but the service is temporarily unavailable (HTTP 5xx). Please try again later.
ui.serverRejected: The server rejected the request (HTTP 4xx). Try again later or contact support if this continues.
ui.serverInvalid: The server returned an unrecognized response. Try again later or contact support if this continues.
ui.downloadInvalid: The download was incomplete or failed security verification, so installation was stopped. Try again or contact support if this keeps happening.
ui.previewIcons: Live preview · using the {n} icons on your desktop
ui.previewNoIcons: Live preview · desktop icons are hidden
ui.refreshTitle: Generate a new scene for this theme
ui.shareImageTitle: Share your desktop image while protecting your privacy
ui.shareVideoTitle: Share your desktop animation while protecting your privacy
ui.sharePrivacy: Icons are replaced with sample icons and file names with color blocks, so none of your files are shown.
ui.shareCopiedImage: The image is on your clipboard — paste it straight into a chat or a post.
ui.shareCopiedVideo: The video file is on your clipboard — paste it into a chat window to send it.
ui.autosave: Changes are saved automatically and applied to your desktop right away
ui.resetAllTitle: Reset all settings of this theme to their defaults
ui.helpWallpaperQ: Deskland-VN keeps flickering or restarting. How do I fix it?
ui.helpWallpaperA: If your regular Windows wallpaper changes automatically, each change can make Deskland-VN flicker or restart. Use a fixed background that does not rotate.
ui.helpWallpaperStep2: Set ‘Personalize your background’ to ‘Picture’ or ‘Solid color’. Do not use ‘Slideshow’ or ‘Windows spotlight’.
ui.helpWallpaperStep3: Restart Deskland-VN after changing this setting.
ui.ongoingDesc: New scenes and elements will be added over time.
ui.noParams: This theme has no settings yet
ui.lockNowTitle: Launch the Deskland-VN live lock screen now (Win+L / Ctrl+Alt+L)
ui.lockWinLLabel: Use Windows + L for live lock screen
ui.lockWinLHint: Pressing Win + L launches Deskland-VN's animated WebGL2 scene and widget instead of the static lock screen
ui.lockWidgetHint: Display a large clock and date while shaping the landscape around the widget
ui.lockPinHint: Uses your Windows account password by default; optionally set a custom PIN here for quick unlock
ui.lockIdleHint: Automatically show the live lock screen when mouse and keyboard are inactive
ui.lockAuthLabel: Require password on live lock screen
ui.lockAuthHint: Show your Windows user profile and require password/PIN sign-in directly over the live WebGL2 wallpaper
ui.lockSyncWinLabel: Sync scene around Windows lock screen clock
ui.lockSyncWinHint: Automatically set a snapshot of your scene (shaped around the Windows 11 clock position) as the system lock screen background
ui.lockSaverNowHint: Show the live scene full screen now; any mouse or key input makes Windows lock and show the sign-in screen
ui.lockSaverNowHintKey: Show the live scene full screen now; any mouse or key input makes Windows lock and show the sign-in screen (Ctrl+Alt+L)
ui.lockSaverIdleHint: Use Deskland-VN as the Windows screen saver, with "on resume, display logon screen" turned on
ui.lockSyncRealLabel: Use scene as Windows lock screen picture
ui.lockSyncRealHint: Capture the current scene as the lock screen background (still image)
ui.lockRealNote: Win+L and the Windows Lock button still show the still-image lock screen: Windows does not let apps draw on the real lock screen. Unlock with your Windows password / PIN / Windows Hello.

host.welcomeBody:
Click the beach icon in the system tray{hotkey} to open the menu.
Can't see it? Click ^ on the right side of the taskbar.
host.errBusyImage: The previous image is still being generated
host.errBusyVideo: The previous clip is still recording
host.errRebuilt: Windows kept rebuilding the wallpaper layer, so Deskland-VN has stopped.
host.errNoDesktop: Couldn't find the desktop window, so the wallpaper can't be attached.

sigma.hint: How far the clouds around your icons spread out

flow.label: Drift speed
flow.hint: How fast the clouds drift and their puffs change

showCat.label: Show kitten
showCat.hint: The little black kitten resting on the grass

palms.label: Coconut palms
palms.hint: Number of coastal palms; 0 to hide. Fewer appear if there is not enough sand.

shallow.label: Shallow sea

turtles.label: Sea turtles
turtles.hint: Slowly swimming sea turtles; set to 0 to hide

lake.name: Lake
lake.desc: Watercolor grass surrounds a clear lake, with painted stones beneath the shallows and crisp reflections of puffy clouds

sigma.label: Grassy shore
sigma.hint: How far the grassy banks extend from your icons

shoal.label: Clear shallows

flow.label: Water movement

time.hint: Follow the clock: dawn at 6:00, day at 7:00, dusk at 17:30, night at 19:00

sigma.label: Cloud size
sigma.hint: How far the clouds spread out from your icons

cover.label: Clouds in the sky
cover.hint: How many clouds drift across the open sky

flow.label: Drift speed
flow.hint: How fast the clouds drift and their puffs change

plane.label: Plane
plane.hint: A little plane trails across the top of the screen

moon.label: Moon
moon.hint: The moon and moonlight at night

stars.label: Star size
stars.hint: Stars at night; turn it up for bright stars with cross-shaped sparkles

ocean.name: Ocean
ocean.desc: Looking down on a blue ocean — your icons hide in white clouds whose shadows fall on the sea

sigma.label: Cloud size
sigma.hint: How far the clouds around your icons spread out

cover.label: Clouds over the sea
cover.hint: How many clouds drift over the open sea

flow.label: Drift speed
flow.hint: How fast the clouds drift and their puffs change

boats.label: Sailboats
boats.hint: White and gray sailboats sailing slowly across open water

yachts.label: Yachts
yachts.hint: White and gray yachts with dark gray windows, pale gray seats and foamy wakes

birds.label: Seabirds
birds.hint: White gulls gliding and circling over the sea

rainforest.name: Tropical Rainforest
rainforest.desc: Mossy clearings ringed by lush tropical rainforest canopy in the rain, with puddle ripples, drifting mist and glowing fireflies

sigma.label: Clearing size
sigma.hint: How big the mossy clearing around your icons is

warp.label: Canopy winding
warp.hint: How much the tropical forest edge winds around your icons

rain.label: Rain & Ripples
rain.hint: Intensity of slanted rain streaks and concentric raindrop ripples

mist.label: Rainforest mist
mist.hint: Soft tropical mist drifting across the treetops

wind.label: Canopy breeze
wind.hint: How much the rainforest canopy sways in the wind

birds.label: Tropical birds
birds.hint: Colorful parrots and kingfishers gliding over the canopy

fireflies.label: Fireflies
fireflies.hint: Glowing fireflies pulsing gently in the rainforest shade

mocchau.name: Plum Blossoms
mocchau.desc: Spring highland meadows ringed by pure white plum blossom hills, morning mist and drifting white petals

sigma.label: Meadow clearing
sigma.hint: How far the spring grass slope extends around your icons

warp.label: Hillside winding
warp.hint: How naturally the plum orchard boundary curves around your icons

bloom.label: Blossom density
bloom.hint: How lush and full the white plum blossom canopies are

petals.label: Floating petals
petals.hint: White plum petals drifting across the highland breeze

wind.label: Highland breeze
wind.hint: How fast the plum branches sway and petals drift

mist.label: Morning mist
mist.hint: Soft highland mist rolling over the hills

birds.label: Highland birds
birds.hint: Little birds gliding over the white blossom valley

tet-sakura.name: Tết Sakura Blossoms
tet-sakura.desc: Warm spring courtyard surrounded by blooming Tết peach and cherry blossoms, red lanterns, lucky envelopes and spring swallows

sigma.label: Courtyard size
sigma.hint: How far the warm spring clearing extends around your icons

warp.label: Branch winding
warp.hint: How naturally the blooming peach and sakura branches curve inward

petals.label: Falling petals
petals.hint: Pink peach and cherry blossom petals dancing in the spring breeze

wind.label: Spring breeze
wind.hint: How gently the branches, lanterns and petals sway

lanterns.label: Lanterns & Lì xì
lanterns.hint: Festive red lanterns and lucky golden-sealed red envelopes hanging on branches

swallows.label: Spring swallows
swallows.hint: Fork-tailed swallows gliding gracefully across the blossoms

cat-hill.name: Sunny Cat Hill
cat-hill.desc: A sunlit green hillside with chubby cats strolling around, sitting to lick their paws, and breathing gently in their sleep beneath swaying trees and falling leaves

cats.label: Number of cats
cats.hint: How many chubby cats walk, groom their fur, and nap across the hillside

butterflies.label: Butterflies
butterflies.hint: Yellow butterflies fluttering around the cats and wildflowers

leaves.label: Falling leaves
leaves.hint: Density of golden and green leaves drifting in the breeze and settling on the grass

wind.label: Hillside breeze
wind.hint: How strongly the trees, bushes, and falling leaves sway in the wind

stadium.name: Football Stadium
stadium.desc: An aerial top-down football stadium with striped turf where two teams pass and move — click anywhere on the pitch to send the ball there as players sprint after it

players.label: Players per team
players.hint: Squad size per side including goalkeeper, from 3v3 mini-pitch up to full 11v11

speed.label: Match tempo
speed.hint: Running speed of the players and pace of the ball across the turf

passFreq.label: Passing frequency
passFreq.hint: Lower for longer solo dribbles, higher for quick one-touch passing

lighting.label: Stadium lighting
lighting.hint: Switch between bright daylight, warm golden sunset, or evening floodlights

stripes.label: Turf stripe contrast
stripes.hint: Contrast between alternating mowed grass bands across the pitch

aquarium.name: Goldfish Bowl
aquarium.desc: A sunlit goldfish bowl seen through the glass: your icons rest on golden sand reefs with swaying weeds and bubbles. Click the water to cast a line, wait for the float to jerk, then click to reel a goldfish in

fish.label: Goldfish
fish.hint: How many goldfish swim in the bowl; a new one swims in after each catch

eager.label: Hungry fish
eager.hint: How quickly a fish comes to nibble and bite after you cast

plants.label: Water weeds
plants.hint: How many green weeds grow on the sand reefs and the bowl floor

bubbles.label: Bubbles
bubbles.hint: How many bubbles rise from the weeds

light.label: Sun rays
light.hint: Strength of the slanted sun rays and caustic light on the sand

sigma.label: Reef width
sigma.hint: How far the golden sand reef extends around your icons

warp.label: Reef curves
warp.hint: Straight, tidy reef edges or natural winding ones

commute.name: Evening Bus
commute.desc: An animated riverside view: the sky follows your clock, the city lights up across the river and a yellow bus rolls past swaying reeds. Click the road to call the bus, the sky for birds or a shooting star, the grass for a gust of wind

time.label: Time of day
time.hint: Sky, sunlight and city lights follow your computer's clock, or stay at a fixed time

busFreq.label: Bus traffic
busFreq.hint: How often the bus passes; click the road to call it at any time

wind.label: Wind
wind.hint: How strongly reeds, clouds and dandelion seeds move

reeds.label: Reeds
reeds.hint: How dense the foreground reeds are

lights.label: City lights
lights.hint: Brightness of street lamps, bridge lights and windows at night

sigma.label: Hill / cloud width
sigma.hint: Icons in the sky rest on clouds, icons below on grassy hills; how wide those areas are

warp.label: Edge curves
warp.hint: Straight, tidy edges or natural winding ones

summer-porch.name: Summer Porch
summer-porch.desc: A Ghibli-inspired watercolor summer veranda: chubby Corgis nap and roll over in front of an oscillating vintage desk fan beside sliced watermelon, an open book and a brass wind chime, while flowering garden beds wrap around your icons. Click a Corgi for belly rubs, toggle the fan, ring the chime or take a bite of watermelon

corgis.label: Corgis on porch
corgis.hint: How many sleepy Corgis lounge on the wooden deck and roll between poses

fanSpeed.label: Desk fan breeze
fanSpeed.hint: Oscillation and airflow speed of the vintage fan fluttering the ribbon and book pages

timeOfDay.label: Time of day
timeOfDay.hint: Switch between bright summer noon, golden sunset, firefly night, or follow your PC clock

sunbeams.label: Sunbeams & fireflies
sunbeams.hint: Warmth of slanted sun rays by day and butterflies or glowing fireflies around the yard

sigma.label: Garden bed width
sigma.hint: Icons in the yard rest on leafy vegetable beds with yellow blossoms, or woven mats on the deck

warp.label: Garden border curves
warp.hint: Neatly trimmed garden borders or organic hand-drawn curves

cats.name: Hillside Kittens
cats.desc: A bright green hilltop under a blue sky overlooking far mountains; trees sway in the wind, golden leaves drift, butterflies flutter and chubby cats stroll, groom and nap belly-up with gentle breathing. Click a cat to pet it, a tree to shake its leaves, or the grass to drop a yarn ball for the cats to chase

mound.label: Mound size
mound.hint: How far the grassy mound spreads around your icons; nearby icons share one mound

cats.label: Cat count
cats.hint: How many chubby cats roam the hills: ginger, grey tabby, tuxedo, calico, black and Siamese

speed.label: Walking speed
speed.hint: Whether the cats amble slowly or trot around

naps.label: Laziness
naps.hint: How likely a cat is to curl up for a nap instead of just sitting

sun.label: Warm sunlight
sun.hint: Brightness of the sunshine falling on the hills

flowers.label: Wildflowers
flowers.hint: Density of daisies and pink and yellow flowers on the hills

bushes.label: Trees & bushes
bushes.hint: How many big trees and bushes dot the hill; cats can walk behind them

wind.label: Wind
wind.hint: Stronger wind sways the bushes and blows more drifting and falling leaves; 0 is calm
